definitions.gloss: out of stock; sold out; inventory depletion
definitions.explanation: the state of having no more items available for sale; when inventory has been exhausted

examples.japanese: その{商品|しょうひん}は{在庫切|ざいこぎ}れです。
examples.english: That product is out of stock.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}{商品|しょうひん}はすぐ{在庫切|ざいこぎ}れになる。
examples.english: Popular products quickly go out of stock.

examples.japanese: {在庫切|ざいこぎ}れで{注文|ちゅうもん}を{受|う}け{付|つ}けられません。
examples.english: We cannot accept orders due to being out of stock.

notes:
FORMS:
{在庫|ざいこ} (inventory, stock) + {切|き}れ (running out, depletion)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {在庫切|ざいこぎ}れになる (to go out of stock)
- {在庫切|ざいこぎ}れで... (because of being out of stock)

RELATED WORDS:
- {在庫|ざいこ}あり (in stock)
- {在庫|ざいこ}{確認|かくにん} (stock check)
- {品切|しなぎ}れ (sold out - synonym)
- {再入荷|さいにゅうか} (restocking)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{品切|しなぎ}れ is used interchangeably and is slightly more common in casual speech.
